name: Shredding Machines
summary: In Windshear Crag, the Venture Company’s shredders wound Stonetalon’s spirits. Seereth Stonebreak hears their cries as XT:4 and XT:9 tear through the forest.

sections.title: A Vision of Deforestation
sections.body: Orc shaman Seereth Stonebreak is stationed along the dusty border between the Barrens and the Stonetalon Mountains. She listens to the unseen realm, though chaos drowns out much of Stonetalon’s spiritual voice. One vision came through with harrowing clarity: man-shaped contraptions tearing through ancient woods with unnatural haste. Marked XT:4 and XT:9, the goblin-engineered shredders butcher Windshear Crag’s timberlands and send waves of distress through the surrounding nature spirits.

sections.title: Silencing the Saws
sections.body: The Venture Company operates in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale. To stem the devastation, Horde champions venture there and track down the logging constructs. Wrecking XT:4 and XT:9 deals a sharp blow to the mountains’ commercial deforestation and calms the immediate cries of wounded tree spirits. Seereth warns that unless the Venture Company abandons Stonetalon entirely, far darker atrocities await the land.

faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak is an orc shaman posted along the southern border between the Barrens and the Stonetalon Mountains. Attuned to the land’s elemental and spiritual forces, she acts as a conduit for forest spirits anguished by the Venture Company’s rapid expansion.

XT:4 and XT:9 are specialized logging shredders operated by the Venture Company in Windshear Crag. Goblin operators pilot these steam-powered mechanical walkers, which cut ancient timber far faster than manual laborers.

aliases: where do i find the shredders
faq.answer: Windshear Crag lies in the northern reaches of the Stonetalon Mountains, northwest of Greatwood Vale. The Venture Company has transformed it into a massive industrial logging basin.

faq.q: Why does a shaman care about trees and druidic magic?
aliases: why do shaman care about trees
faq.answer: As Seereth explains, shamanistic communion with spirits shares close ties with druidic nature magic. Trauma inflicted on living forests echoes into the spiritual realm, letting perceptive shaman hear slaughtered tree spirits’ wails alongside elemental unrest.

faq.q: Who owns and operates these shredders?
faq.answer: The shredders belong to the Venture Company, an unscrupulous, goblin-run commercial conglomerate infamous across Azeroth for ruthlessly stripping valuable natural resources without regard for local ecosystems or ancestral inhabitants.

faq.q: Does destroying XT:4 and XT:9 drive the Venture Company away?
faq.answer: No. Destroying these machines calms the weeping tree spirits and sets back local logging, but the Venture Company keeps an extensive industrial foothold across Windshear Crag. Defenders of the wild must continue resisting its presence.

angles.text: Seereth points to the close ties between spiritual magic and nature. Elemental balance depends on defending the spirits that inhabit the land.
The desecration of Stonetalon’s ancient forests by soulless goblin machinery violates devotion to the Earth Mother.
The XT-series logging mechs show advanced goblin shredder design, joining mechanical hydraulic saws with steam locomotion.
As the Horde establishes footholds across Kalimdor, checking the Venture Company’s unregulated greed matters for preserving the land and keeping transit through Stonetalon safe.
